source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Salt Hydrolysis, printed as a second topic 9.8 on page 204.

blocks.text: Jab salt pani mein halta hai to woh apne ions mein dissociate hota hai. Yeh ions pani se amal kar sakte hain, aur solution ka pH is par munhasir hai ke salt kis acid aur base se bana hai. Chaar soorten, strong ya weak acids ke strong ya weak bases ke saath salts, agle chaar topics mein hain.

blocks.title: Salt hydrolysis
blocks.text: Salt hydrolysis hal shuda salt ke ions ka pani se reaction hai, jo asal acid aur base ki taqat ke mutabiq solution ko tezabi, basic ya neutral banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kuch salts halne par pani ka pH kyun badalte hain jabke doosre nahi?
blocks.explanation: Hal shuda ion pH sirf tab badalta hai jab woh pani se react kare: kamzor acid ka conjugate base pani se proton le kar OH- chhorta hai, aur kamzor base ka conjugate acid pani ko proton de kar H3O+ banata hai. Strong acids ya strong bases se bane ions itne kamzor conjugates hain ke react nahi karte, to solution neutral rehta hai.

items: Salt ke ions pani se react (hydrolyse) kar ke pH badal sakte hain; nateeja is par munhasir hai ke asal acid aur base strong the ya weak.
